- `Home`, `HomeOutOfStock` in `index.stories.tsx`, and `Home_Desktop_Default`, `Home_Desktop_Unavailable`, `Home_Mobile_Default`, `Home_Mobile_Unavailable` in `nodeCoverage/index.stories.tsx` — Home's `VARIATION_CONFIG.showSizeChips` is `false`, no size-chip slot renders at all for these.
- `Hero_ExcludedNotInScope` in `nodeCoverage/index.stories.tsx` — not a real card render.

When done, report every file touched and the exact diff shape, confirm `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, and confirm `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/index.test.tsx` still passes (56 tests) — stories aren't executed by Vitest, but run it to be sure nothing else broke. Do not stage, do not commit.

export const SIZES: ZimmSizeChipValue[] = [
  { value: 'xs', label: 'XS' },
  { value: 's', label: 'S' },
  { value: 'm', label: 'M' },
  { value: 'l', label: 'L' },
];

/**
 * Wraps `ZimmProductCard` so `selectedSizeChipValue` is genuinely live rather than a static arg —
 * neither `ZimmProductCard` nor the `ZimmSizeChipGroup` it composes tracks selection itself (both
 * are correctly controlled components), so any story that wants a chip click to visually select
 * must own that state itself, the same pattern zimmSizeChipGroup/index.stories.tsx's
 * `KeyboardNavigation` story already uses via its own `KeyboardNavigationExample`. Originally
 * `../index.stories.tsx`'s own `DefaultExample`, moved here so every enabled-size-chip story
 * across both `../index.stories.tsx` and `./nodeCoverage/index.stories.tsx` can share one
 * implementation instead of each retyping it. Every arg passes straight through unchanged; only
 * `selectedSizeChipValue`/`onSizeChipSelect` become live. `onSizeChipSelectFromArgs` still fires
 * the original `args.onSizeChipSelect` (each story's own `fn()` spy) so Storybook's Actions panel
 * keeps logging the click.
 *
 * `onSizeChipSelect`/`selectedSizeChipValue` only exist on the `plp`/`wishlist` members of
 * `ZimmProductCardProps`'s discriminated union (see index.tsx) — `home` has neither. Narrowing via
 * the `variation` discriminant into a single `propsWithLiveSelection` value (rather than spreading
 * `args` and adding those two as separate attributes) matters for real, not just style: once
 * narrowed, `{...args, selectedSizeChipValue, onSizeChipSelect}` is a proper subtype of the
 * `plp`/`wishlist` branch and assigns cleanly to the wider union; attaching the same two
 * attributes directly on top of an unnarrowed `{...args}` spread does NOT — TypeScript distributes
 * that spread per union branch and rejects them on the `home` branch, unlike the lenient "excess
 * property on any one member" behaviour `index.test.tsx` documents for a plain object-literal
 * assignment (confirmed the hard way in this component's original `DefaultExample` draft: `npx
 * tsc --noEmit` correctly rejected it).
 *
 * NOTE: this local state always initialises to `undefined`, regardless of any
 * `selectedSizeChipValue` a caller's `args` supplies — a story that pre-selects a chip via static
 * args (e.g. `../index.stories.tsx`'s `Wishlist`, matching its own `size: 'M'` attribute and a
 * specific Figma reference) will render with nothing selected once wired through this wrapper,
 * because the local state is spread onto `propsWithLiveSelection` AFTER `...args` and always wins.
 * Flagged, not fixed here — out of scope for the wiring-only change this wrapper's move was part
 * of; fixing it would mean seeding this wrapper's initial state from `args.selectedSizeChipValue`,
 * a behavioural change, not a wiring one.
 *
 * `createElement` rather than JSX: this module is `.ts`, not `.tsx` (the rest of the file is plain
 * fixture data with no rendering concern), and TypeScript only parses JSX syntax inside a `.tsx`
 * file — confirmed directly (`npx tsc` rejects a bare `<Foo />` in a `.ts` file with a parse
 * error, not a type error). Behaviourally identical to a JSX
 * `<ZimmProductCard {...propsWithLiveSelection} />` call, since JSX is sugar for exactly this — a
 * syntax-level substitution only, not a logic change from this wrapper's original form.
 */
export const LiveSizeSelectionCard = (args: ZimmProductCardProps) => {
  const [selectedSizeChipValue, setSelectedSizeChipValue] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const isSizeChipVariation = args.variation === 'plp' || args.variation === 'wishlist';
  const onSizeChipSelectFromArgs = isSizeChipVariation ? args.onSizeChipSelect : undefined;
  const handleSizeChipSelect = (value: string) => {
    setSelectedSizeChipValue(value);
    onSizeChipSelectFromArgs?.(value);
  };
  const propsWithLiveSelection: ZimmProductCardProps = isSizeChipVariation
    ? { ...args, selectedSizeChipValue, onSizeChipSelect: handleSizeChipSelect }
    : args;

57	 * implementation instead of each retyping it. Every arg passes straight through unchanged; only

59	 * the original `args.onSizeChipSelect` (each story's own `fn()` spy) so Storybook's Actions panel

63	 * `ZimmProductCardProps`'s discriminated union (see index.tsx) — `home` has neither. Narrowing via

65	 * `args` and adding those two as separate attributes) matters for real, not just style: once
66	 * narrowed, `{...args, selectedSizeChipValue, onSizeChipSelect}` is a proper subtype of the
67	 * `plp`/`wishlist` branch and assigns cleanly to the wider union; attaching the same two
68	 * attributes directly on top of an unnarrowed `{...args}` spread does NOT — TypeScript distributes
69	 * that spread per union branch and rejects them on the `home` branch, unlike the lenient "excess
70	 * property on any one member" behaviour `index.test.tsx` documents for a plain object-literal
71	 * assignment (confirmed the hard way in this component's original `DefaultExample` draft: `npx

80	 * of; fixing it would mean seeding this wrapper's initial state from `args.selectedSizeChipValue`,
81	 * a behavioural change, not a wiring one.

84	 * fixture data with no rendering concern), and TypeScript only parses JSX syntax inside a `.tsx`
85	 * file — confirmed directly (`npx tsc` rejects a bare `<Foo />` in a `.ts` file with a parse
86	 * error, not a type error). Behaviourally identical to a JSX
87	 * `<ZimmProductCard {...propsWithLiveSelection} />` call, since JSX is sugar for exactly this — a
88	 * syntax-level substitution only, not a logic change from this wrapper's original form.
89	 */
90	export const LiveSizeSelectionCard = (args: ZimmProductCardProps) => {
91	  const [selectedSizeChipValue, setSelectedSizeChipValue] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
92	  const isSizeChipVariation = args.variation === 'plp' || args.variation === 'wishlist';
93	  const onSizeChipSelectFromArgs = isSizeChipVariation ? args.onSizeChipSelect : undefined;

97	  };
98	  const propsWithLiveSelection: ZimmProductCardProps = isSizeChipVariation
99	    ? { ...args, selectedSizeChipValue, onSizeChipSelect: handleSizeChipSelect }
100	    : args;
101	  return createElement(ZimmProductCard, propsWithLiveSelection);
102	};
